elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to 6 months

elements.element: Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to Corio all Corio and Customer data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems
certify such deletion to Corio in writing
for a period of up to 6 months at Commerce One's then-current rates
within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to Corio all Corio and Customer data

reasons: The inserted Section 11.4 supplies every preferred atomic element: up to 6 months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Corio/Customer data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days measured from expiration or termination (not from a request), and deletion followed by written certification.

The 'at Corio's request' condition attaches only to the transition-assistance limb; the 30-day data return and the deletion/certification duties remain unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the mandatory data return.

Minimal: the original clause 11.3 was silent on data return and transition, and the drafter added a single concise new subsection rather than rewriting 11.3; all existing survival, support-and-maintenance and Confidential Information retention terms remain intact and effective.

Minor non-flagging notes: 'reasonable' qualifies the assistance and the assistance limb is request-triggered; these are sub-elements short of ideal wording, not material failures. No undefined terms or dangling mechanics are introduced.
